facts.text: Big hair, big plates, and everybody gets to dance after dinner. Mum made her famous pie, so save room.
facts.why: Nothing opened mentions a famous pie. Tracy calls her mother 'Ma' ('Ma, it's changing out there!'), and Edna is an agoraphobic laundress who comes into the story at the plus-size boutique.
facts.fix: Big hair, big plates, and everybody dances after dinner. Ma says nobody leaves hungry, so save room.
